record.body: Post-R44 graph delta: R44 #246 merged exact 2db35c65... -> main 9e7586be.... The merge exposed two canonical R43 defects: missing deterministic ORDER BY on 1000x-shortfall evidence and missing workflow timeout bound. Stale repair #247 independently evolved to d0545b5e and merged concurrently as 7d158ef97c6f41a67933f501397e29729abef071. PORTFOLIO had already reconstructed the same semantics on exact R44 main in #248 and added a permanent deterministic-order falsifier; exact #248 head 8c7a998b56ce14434d91023d6d36ccb20adca9e0 achieved R43 owning SUCCESS + Vacuity SUCCESS + aggregate CI SUCCESS, then merged with expected-head fence as 8b97179940c5d748f994c10bfc64261743b6fde1. #248 merge tree is identical to parent #247 tree, so it is recorded as topology/containment closure, not additional unique semantic capital. Exact containment holds for #248: merge_base=8c7a998b..., behind=0. Current marketplace default=8b971799.... Durable rule: concurrent equivalent repairs must be deduplicated by resulting tree/capability identity, not double-counted as semantic production.
